Qui cogitat mala facere stultus vocabitur:
Whoever intends to do evil shall be called foolish.
The intention of the foolish is sin.
And the detractor is an abomination among men.
Si desperaveris lassus in die angustiæ,
If you despair, being weary in the day of anguish,
Erue eos qui ducuntur ad mortem,
Rescue those who are led away to death.
et qui trahuntur ad interitum, liberare ne cesses.
And do not cease from delivering those who are dragged away to a violent death.
qui inspector est cordis ipse intelligit:
He who inspects the heart, the same one understands,
et servatorem animæ tuæ nihil fallit,
and nothing slips past the one who preserves your soul.

Cum ceciderit inimicus tuus ne gaudeas,
When your enemy will fall, do not be glad,
et in ruina ejus ne exsultet cor tuum:
and do not let your heart exult in his ruin,

Cognoscere personam in judicio non est bonum.

Those who say to the impious,
shall be cursed by the people,
and the tribes shall detest them.
Those who argue against the impious shall be praised,
and a blessing shall come upon them.
Labia deosculabitur qui recta verba respondet.

Ne sis testis frustra contra proximum tuum,
Do not be a witness without cause against your neighbor.

Quomodo fecit mihi, sic faciam ei;
“I will do to him as he has done to me.”
I will repay each one according to his work.
I passed by the field of a lazy man,
and by the vineyard of a foolish man,
and behold, it was entirely filled with nettles,
and thorns had covered its surface,

You will fold your hands a little,
et veniet tibi quasi cursor egestas,
